lines: Baad-e-naubahaar chale
couplets.en: Let the breeze of early spring blow.

lines: Gulon mein rang bhare, baad-e-naubahaar chale
Chale bhi aao ke gulshan ka kaarobaar chale
couplets.en: Let color fill the flowers and the spring breeze blow, come so the garden may come to life again.

lines: Baad-e-naubahaar chale
couplets.en: Let the breeze of early spring blow.

lines: Qafas udaas hai, yaaro, saba se kuchh to kaho
Qafas udaas hai, yaaro, saba se kuchh to kaho
couplets.en: The cage is sad, friends, say something to the morning breeze.

lines: Kaheen to bahr-e-khuda aaj zikr-e-yaar chale
Chale bhi aao ke gulshan ka kaarobaar chale
couplets.en: For God's sake, let someone speak of you today, and come so the garden may come to life again.

lines: Gulon mein rang bhare, baad-e-naubahaar chale
couplets.en: Let color fill the flowers and the spring breeze blow.

lines: Jo hum pe guzri so guzri
Jo hum pe guzri so guzri
couplets.en: What we went through has passed.

lines: Jo hum pe guzri so guzri, magar shab-e-hijraan
Hamaare ashk tiri aaqibat sanwaar chale
couplets.en: What we went through has passed, yet our tears, O night of separation, went some way toward redeeming you.

lines: Chale bhi aao ke gulshan ka kaarobaar chale
Gulon mein rang bhare, baad-e-naubahaar chale
couplets.en: Come so the garden may live again, with color in its flowers and a breeze of early spring.

lines: Kabhi to subh tire kunj-e-lab se ho aaghaaz
couplets.en: Let morning begin, for once, in the shelter of your lips.

lines: Kabhi to subh tire kunj-e-lab se ho aaghaaz
Kabhi to shab sar-e-kaakul se mushkbaar chale
couplets.en: Let morning begin in the shelter of your lips, and let night pass scented with musk from your hair.

lines: Chale bhi aao ke gulshan ka kaarobaar chale
Gulon mein rang bhare, baad-e-naubahaar chale
couplets.en: Come so the garden may live again, with color in its flowers and a breeze of early spring.

lines: Woh jo teer-e-neem-kash
couplets.en: That arrow drawn only halfway.

lines: Woh jo teer-e-neem-kash, to kya haasil
Woh jo teer-e-neem-kash, to kya haasil
couplets.en: What good is an arrow drawn only halfway?

lines: Maza to jab hai ke seene ke aar-paar chale
Maza to jab hai ke seene ke aar-paar chale
couplets.en: The pleasure comes when it passes clean through the chest.

lines: Chale bhi aao ke gulshan ka kaarobaar chale
Gulon mein rang bhare, baad-e-naubahaar chale
couplets.en: Come so the garden may live again, with color in its flowers and a breeze of early spring.

lines: Maqaam, Faiz, koi
Maqaam, Faiz, koi
couplets.en: Some place to rest, Faiz.

lines: Maqaam, Faiz, koi
Maqaam, Faiz, koi
couplets.en: Some place to rest, Faiz.

lines: Maqaam, Faiz, koi raah mein jacha hi naheen
Jo koo-e-yaar se nikle to soo-e-daar chale
couplets.en: No place along the way felt right, Faiz, so when we left the beloved's lane we made for the gallows.
